dpdp_statutory_modeling.commencement_notification_ref: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology Notification G.S.R. 843(E) dated 13 November 2025
dpdp_statutory_modeling.jurisdiction: India (The Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023)
penalty_determination_factors: Nature, gravity, and duration of the breach (Section 33(2)(a)).
Type and nature of the personal data affected by the breach (Section 33(2)(b)).
Whether the data fiduciary realized any gain or avoided any loss as a result of the breach (Section 33(2)(d)).
Mitigation actions taken to reduce consequences and timeliness/effectiveness of such action (Section 33(2)(e)).
Proportionality and effectiveness of the proposed monetary penalty (Section 33(2)(f)).
Likely financial impact on the entity being penalized (Section 33(2)(g)).
dpdp_statutory_modeling.pre_commencement_liability_clarification: Section 33 monetary penalty framework and The Schedule are not in force before scheduled commencement (13 May 2027); this reflects that Section 33 statutory fines are not currently enforceable, but does not imply all DPDP legal exposure or all other statutory liability is zero as Clause (a) governance and preliminary provisions are in force.
